opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and occasionally to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, supporting projects that help pupils at secondary level develop skills for employment or independent living.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authority. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for organisations working with disability, supporting projects that help people live more independently, particularly training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for charities working in mental health, with emphasis on projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with neurodegenerative conditions or who are isolated.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for hospices and palliative care organisations towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment to support excellent care to patients and their families.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections, usually for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for museums and galleries to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for performing arts organisations to improve their training and education facilities, generally towards building or refurbishment of these facilities and occasionally specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for organisations with significant scientific or natural history collections to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges to improve the teaching at GCSE and A-Level of subjects that need specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music and performing arts).
